title: Offer the Queen Twice
setup: Black's queen on e3 already eyes the squares around your king on f6, backed by rooks on d7 and e5 — you are one move from mate.
hint: Both of your checks put the queen where it can be taken. Work out why neither capture is legal.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qg2+}} is protected by the rook on g6, so {{Kf4}} is forced, and {{Qg4#}} offers the queen a second time on a square the king cannot take from. A defense that relies on being unable to capture is still a defense.
